queries.query:
from(bucket: "efd/autogen")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._measurement == "lsst.sal.HVAC.coatingGlycolChiller04" and
    (r._field == "compressor01Working" or
     r._field == "compressor02Working" or
     r._field == "compressor04Working")
  )
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: if r._value then 1.0 else 0.0 }))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r._value * 100.0 }))
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> rename(columns: {
      compressor01Working: "mean_compressor01Working_pct",
      compressor02Working: "mean_compressor02Working_pct",
      compressor04Working: "mean_compressor04Working_pct"
  })
